title: Minnie Rodwin oral history interview
orientation: An oral history interview with Minnie Rodwin, recorded on February 12, 1997, in Sunrise, Florida, by Janet Levine for the National Park Service. Rodwin was 90 years old at the time of the interview. The transcript begins with a typed archival block listing birthdate, running time, interviewer, recording engineer, location, ship, and transcript credits, followed by the dialogue. Levine, the interviewer, guides Rodwin through recollections of her early childhood in London's East End, her parents' origins in Poland and the Polish-Russian border region, the family's 1910 emigration aboard the ship Philadelphia, arrival in New York, settlement on the Lower East Side, her father's bakery, siblings, and later life in the United States. The exchange closes with closing remarks and a sign-off.
